explanation.bottleneck: The measured baseline critical path is a state flip-flop through the three-input bill OR gate to the loaded output, with 0.70 ns arrival and 9.30 ns slack. The next reported state-transition path already has only 9.38 ns slack, so removing the output gate alone offers limited headroom.
explanation.rewrite: Use explicit one-hot transition equations and add a redundant bill-status register. Compute that register from the destination-state bill predicate so bill changes on exactly the original clock edge. For the default parameters, all outputs become direct register outputs. The ten-priority input qualification is shared explicitly.
explanation.functional_boundaries: Preserves the module interface and parameter declarations, single positive-edge clock, synchronous active-high clear, and output latency. After the specified reset, the six state flags remain one-hot and s_bill equals the union of the three bill-state flags. Simultaneous ten and twenty selects ten. Any later clear restores ready and clears the other flags on that same edge. No additional startup cycles, assumptions, initialization, or dependencies are introduced. Equivalence is required against the frozen original under the fixed startup contract; arbitrary unreset or corrupted internal encodings are not claimed equivalent.
explanation.expected_timing_gain: The candidate targets removal of the measured bill output OR gate; no candidate improvement has been measured. The new bill-register D cone, particularly the BILL20 hold/ten condition and the four-term combination, can become critical. Existing state-transition paths and reset gating also compete. The baseline 9.38 ns competing slack is not a candidate prediction; synthesis and STA must establish strict WNS improvement and non-regressing TNS.
explanation.area_or_other_cost: Expected register count is seven versus the baseline six, subject to synthesis optimization. One additional dfxtp_1 costs 20.0192 um2, leaving only 5.25504 um2 of the allowed incremental area if everything else were unchanged. Removing the loaded output OR and restructuring transition logic may offset some added bill-input logic, but buffer sizing, reset fanout, and combinational mapping can exceed the 278.01664 um2 cap. Area compliance requires measurement.
